hook_text: Of what? The two words that save the mark
clip_script:
The problem that catches almost everyone is the one with a remainder, so let us walk through the money slowly. Six hundred rand in your pocket. You spend one third on groceries. One third of six hundred is two hundred — the of question, multiply. You have four hundred left. Then you spend one quarter of what is left on airtime. Stop. Of what? Of what is left. Not of six hundred. Of four hundred. One quarter of four hundred is one hundred. Now you have three hundred rand.

The wrong turn is taking a quarter of the original six hundred, one hundred and fifty, and ending with two hundred and fifty. The story said of the remainder, and the remainder was four hundred. Every time you see a fraction in a word problem, ask of what, and point at the amount it belongs to.
visual_style: Banknotes split into blocks on a table; a tank filling and draining with fraction labels
pacing: deliberate, pausing on each of what
